remarks: Welcome to 544 Adams St., one of 12 newly built homes for sale. This beautiful ranch home in Buffalo, NY, features 3 bedrooms, an open floor plan, and abundant natural sunlight throughout. Enjoy the convenience of 1st-floor laundry, a 1-car garage, and a full basement with egress window, offering great potential for additional living space or storage. Located in a neighborhood revitalization area, this home is a wonderful opportunity to enjoy modern living in a growing community. This home is an income-restricted, owner-occupied opportunity. Buyers must meet program eligibility requirements and be pre-approved.
